verdict.rationale: For a chip, a documented programming interface is a fair axis, and Apple documents Metal as the public API for driving Apple-designed GPUs, including Metal 4 and the GPU Neural Accelerators on the M4 family. The docs are framed generically rather than as an M4 Pro-specific control surface, nothing addresses agent-oriented driving of the chip, and the llms.txt probe returned 404. missing for 10: M4 Pro-specific API documentation, agent/AI-native oriented interface or machine-readable docs (llms.txt 404), independent hands-on corroboration of programmatic control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Metal puts the advanced capabilities of Apple-designed GPUs at your fingertips.
It supports Metal 4 and GPU Neural Accelerators for maximum performance
